The affected_versions list in the advisory covers 33 specific versions shipped on conda-forge in the 5.x through 8.6.0 range, which aligns with the OSV ecosystem range. The fix was released upstream in 8.6.1, and since conda-forge has already published 9.1.0, the current latest build is not affected, but many historical conda-forge builds remain vulnerable.
